empty.title: Ask your memory.
empty.body: Every answer shows, sentence by sentence, what Cogeto can prove, and honestly marks what it can't. The web is searched only when you ask and approve.
empty.workspaceNote: This is one conversation: a workspace for one thread of work. Anything captured here becomes memory and answers in every other conversation too.

composer.label: Ask a question
composer.hint: Enter to send · Shift+Enter for a new line · every claim shows what it can prove

remember.title: Remember this message. It becomes memory through the normal pipeline

researchOffer.error: Couldn't prepare that research. Try the Research page.
researchOffer.alwaysTitle: Cogeto will check the web automatically from now on. You can turn this off in Settings.

unsourced.label: unsourced
unsourced.title: Model knowledge, not from your sources. Cogeto marks these so you always know which claims it can prove.
unsourced.ariaLabel: model knowledge, not from your sources

conversation.emptyRail: A conversation is a workspace for one thread of thinking: a client, a contract, quick questions. Start one and ask.
conversation.railFooter: What Cogeto learns here is remembered everywhere: conversations organise talk, memory keeps knowledge.

delete.question: Delete "{{label}}"?
delete.consequence: This deletes the conversation, its {{messages}}, and the {{memories}} derived from them, with a signed receipt.
delete.approvedNote_one: Note: {{count}} of those memories was approved by you.
delete.approvedNote_other: Note: {{count}} of those memories were approved by you.
delete.alternative: Archiving keeps everything instead. This cannot be undone.

attachment.transientMeaning: Used only in this conversation: the file is read once, its bytes are discarded right after, and the extracted text stays with this conversation until you delete the conversation. It never becomes a source or a memory, and no other conversation can see it.
attachment.durableHint: This file will be added to your sources: read, its facts extracted and verified, kept with full provenance.
attachment.failed: This file could not be processed.
attachment.transientReady: Read for this conversation. Ask about it here; it was not remembered.
attachment.truncatedNote: The file was read in part; open the source for what was left out.
